item.title: Boticario: Words Leave Marks
item.description: O Boticario, a Brazilian cosmetics company elected the best brand to give for Christmas,* is launching its Christmas campaign with a five-minute short that seeks to spark reflection on intra-family stress and the impact that words can have on our closest relationships. The inspiration came from a poll sponsored by the brand, conducted by consulting firm On The Go. The results revealed that 86% of Brazilians have been the victims of family bullying, but just 17% of them discuss the issue openly.
